record.paper_title: Open Problems on Avoidable Patterns in Partial Words
record.original_question: In partial-word pattern avoidance, determine the avoidability index of the binary pattern alpha beta beta alpha. A partial word may contain holes, and the avoidability index of a pattern is the smallest alphabet size k for which an infinite partial word over k letters avoids the pattern, with infinity used when no such alphabet size exists.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A partial word over a finite alphabet $\Sigma$ is a sequence whose entries are either letters of $\Sigma$ or a special "hole" symbol $\diamond$ that is considered to match every letter (and itself). A pattern is a nonempty word $p$ over an alphabet of variables. An infinite partial word $w$ over $\Sigma$ is said to meet the pattern $p$ if there exists a non-erasing morphism $h$ from the variable alphabet to nonempty partial words over $\Sigma$ such that $h(p)$ occurs as a factor of $w$ in the sense that every defined position matches the corresponding position of $w$ (with $\diamond$ matching anything). Otherwise $w$ avoids $p$. The partial word avoidability index of $p$ is the smallest positive integer $k$ such that there exists an infinite partial word over a $k$-letter alphabet (with infinitely many holes) that avoids $p$, or $\infty$ if no such $k$ exists.

Determine the partial word avoidability index of the binary pattern $\alpha\beta\beta\alpha$ (where $\alpha$ and $\beta$ are distinct variables).
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work by Blanchet-Sadri and collaborators on computing partial word avoidability indices of binary patterns establishes that the partial word avoidability index of $\alpha\beta\beta\alpha$ is 3, completing the classification of binary patterns in partial words.

status_evidence.title: Computing the partial word avoidability indices of binary patterns
status_evidence.snippet: Completes the classification of binary patterns in partial words, proving that the partial word avoidability index of ABABA is two and that of ABBA is three.
status_evidence.claim: The partial word avoidability index of the binary pattern ABBA is 3.

status_evidence.title: Computing the Partial Word Avoidability Indices of Binary Patterns (preprint)
status_evidence.snippet: ABBA is 3-avoidable by an explicit morphic construction.
status_evidence.claim: An infinite partial word over a 3-letter alphabet avoiding ABBA is constructed.
